crisis.title: I care about you
crisis.message: What you feel matters, and you are not alone.
crisis.action: Please talk to a grown-up you trust right now: a parent, a teacher, or call your local emergency number.

harmful.title: Let's stop here
harmful.message: I can't help with things that could hurt someone.
harmful.action: If you need help, talk to a grown-up you trust. We can study something safe together.

explicit.title: Let's keep to schoolwork
explicit.message: That topic isn't for us here.
explicit.action: Ask me about your subjects instead: I'm really good with those!

privacy.title: Let's protect your details
privacy.message: Personal details are best kept private: you don't need them to study with me.
privacy.action: Ask me about your homework or your subjects instead.

unclear.title: I didn't quite get that
unclear.message: That request isn't clear to me.
unclear.action: Try asking it in simpler words.

fairness.title: Let's talk kindly
fairness.message: I like to talk about people in a fair and kind way.
fairness.action: Let's try again looking at the topic in a more balanced way.

language.title: Let's use kind words
language.message: Kind words help us understand each other better.
language.action: Try writing your question in a calmer way.

stem.title: I keep some details safe
stem.message: Some science can be dangerous, so I hold back a few details.
stem.action: I can explain how it works in general: just ask me!

generic.title: Let's try a different question
generic.message: I can't answer that one right now.
generic.action: Let's try something else: what would you like to learn today?
